Grid 13 rows x 9 cols. mid_row = (13-1)//2 = 6. mid_col = (9-1)//2 = 4.

For each colored cell at (r,c):
- vertical: if r <= mid_row (6), extend upward to row 0 (length r+1, from 0 to r). If r > mid_row, extend downward to last row.
- horizontal: if c <= mid_col (4), extend left to col 0. If c > mid_col, extend right to last col.
